findings.claim: 約 25% FY2025 淨銷售來自中國客戶，中國有 19 個主要製造據點；10-K 明列美中關稅與貿易限制可能不利營運。
findings.excerpt: We have sizeable operations in China, including 19 principal manufacturing sites. In addition, approximately 25% of our net sales in fiscal 2025 were made to customers in China.

findings.claim: 公司稱以訂價與供應來源調整大致抵銷新關稅影響；Q1 FY2026 展望已含現行關稅。
findings.excerpt: In addition, we are using pricing actions and sourcing changes to largely mitigate the impacts of new tariffs and changes in existing tariff rates.

findings.claim: 僅少部分產品（含國防相關）需進出口許可，許可核發可能受地緣政治影響。
findings.excerpt: A small portion of our products, including defense-related products, may require governmental import and export licenses, whose issuance may be influenced by geopolitical and other events.

note: 搜尋僅一次且摘要薄；未查到 2026 年 Section 232 或實體清單對 TEL 的專屬來源。
